CommandRecord.description:
A CLI command invocation: name, arguments, exit code, and optional reason.

The ``exit_code`` / ``reason`` pairing is constrained: a zero exit has no
reason, and a non-zero exit always carries one.

args.description: Arguments the command was invoked with.
args.title: Args

at.description: Nanoseconds since the Unix epoch when the record was created.
at.title: At

exit_code.description: Process-style exit code: 0 success, 1 or 2 failure.
exit_code.title: Exit Code

reason.description: Why the command exited non-zero, when it did.
reason.title: Reason

seq.description: Iteration sequence number, present on per-iteration records.
seq.title: Seq

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header for distributed tracing.
traceparent.title: Traceparent

Confirm.description:
A confirmation rerun: which metrics it re-measured, and the samples it took.

``absent`` names metrics the rerun was asked about but skipped; it is
``None`` on a log written before the field existed.

absent.title: Absent

filtered.description: Metric names the rerun was filtered to.
filtered.title: Filtered

ran.description: Whether the confirmation rerun actually executed.
ran.title: Ran

samples.description: Sample rounds collected during the confirmation rerun.

IterationRecord.description:
One measured edit: raw samples, per-metric verdicts, and the outcome.

``duration_ms`` is the wall-clock milliseconds from the readiness guard
passing to the record being appended -- the before hook, both bench sides,
the confirmation rerun, and judging.  It excludes the after hook.

undefined; the field is always present so a dropped delta reads as a broken
writer, not a degenerate measurement.
